Material Inventory

Surface labels on this site are provisional. The classifier was scored against two hand-labelled tile sets and does not exceed a null model that answers the two commonest features and looks at nothing. The geometric descriptors are computed deterministically and are verified. A rebar_visible negative is absent evidence, not evidence of absence, and is not drilling guidance. Models in the 3D viewers are decimated for the browser; the full-resolution meshes are archived separately. Evaluation and sources: repository README.
